title: Dashboard Customer Link Permission Consistency

items.action: open a customer card from Dashboard recent activities

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.customers.read permission is reused.

backend.reason: Dashboard organization access and existing backend customer authorization remain unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contracts change; only Dashboard customer navigation visibility is aligned with customer read authorization.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend query or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: Customer detail access already fails closed without fair_crm.customers.read; this change aligns the originating Dashboard link.

notes: Dashboard summary access requires authenticated organization access but no RBAC permission. Recent activity customer names were nevertheless rendered as customer-card links for every Dashboard user, while customer detail reads require fair_crm.customers.read and fail closed without it. The Dashboard now renders those names as links only when customer read permission is granted; otherwise the same summary data remains visible as plain text.
